//factions: Declared by HUE, not by design token. The Revolution pack names tokens
because a designer tuned that palette by hand; a new subject has nobody
to tune it yet, and core/palette.js derives fill and wash from the hue so
seven parties sit together instead of being invented one at a time.
Seven, and two of them change sides. Octavian and Antony are allies in 43
and enemies in 32, which is exactly the thing four hardcoded names could
not express: a `side` is who someone is fighting for in THIS beat.

//borders: No modern national borders, at any level. Drawing Italy's 2024 frontier
across Cisalpine Gaul is the 'Massachusetts included Maine' mistake at
ten times the scale. The provinces come from the pack's own geometry.
map.//accuracyNote: Rendered once per chapter beside the credit. A known inaccuracy said out loud is a fact worth knowing; left unsaid it is a lie.

accuracyNote.no: Kystlinjen er dagens. På Octavians tid lå Ostia ved havet, og Nilen hadde sju munninger.
accuracyNote.en: The coastline is the modern one. In Octavian's day Ostia stood on the sea, and the Nile had seven mouths.

//era: -0044 is 44 BC, not ISO's astronomical -44. See core/era.js.
Julian, because that is how the sources date it and converting would move
the Ides of March off 15 March. The calendar is itself a teachable fact
here: Caesar had imposed it fifteen months earlier.

calendarNote.no: Datoene følger den julianske kalenderen, som Cæsar innførte i 45 f.Kr. — bare et år før han ble drept.
calendarNote.en: Dates follow the Julian calendar, which Caesar imposed in 45 BC — just a year before he was killed.

era.//end: AD 37, the year Tiberius died. -0044 means 44 BC; see core/era.js.

blurb.no: En nittenåring arver et navn, og bruker sytten år på å gjøre det om til enevelde.
blurb.en: A nineteen-year-old inherits a name, and spends seventeen years turning it into sole rule.

chapters.//langs: Both recorded. The engine only probes for what is listed here.

title.en: The peace, and what it cost

blurb.no: Han styrte i førtien år og kalte seg aldri konge. Da han døde, var republikken borte, og nesten ingen hadde sett det skje.
blurb.en: He ruled for forty-one years and never called himself king. By the time he died the republic was gone, and almost nobody had seen it go.

blurb.no: Tiberius ville ikke ha jobben, tok den i tjuetre år, og tilbrakte de siste elleve på en øy. Riket merket det knapt.
blurb.en: Tiberius did not want the job, held it for twenty-three years, and spent the last eleven on an island. The empire barely noticed.

checks.//: Where the pixel checks point their camera. s5.b10 is the beat with every province on screen at once - Octavian's west against Antony's east after 36 BC. `at` is 7.5s because the two region.show cues are anchored to the words 'vest' and 'ost', which land 4.8s and 6.0s into the beat; sampling earlier finds an empty map and reports it as no data rather than as a fail.

description.no: Fra Cæsars død til Tiberius’ – hvordan republikken ble et keiserrike, og hva det kostet.
description.en: From the death of Caesar to the death of Tiberius – how a republic became an empire, and what it cost.

generated.//: Photographic-looking generated plates are refused while allowPhoto is false. badge draws the "illustration" mark on every kind:made picture.
